decision.next_action: Past-only and deviation-from-personal-sleep-baseline features do not open Q3/S3 against ID342. Keep this as negative domain evidence and do not escalate to Kaggle, artifacts, or DACON.

processed_metadata.source_note: Uses existing processed df_train_raw columns derived from phone/watch sensors around sleep_date; no new feature matrix is materialized.

purpose: Fold-internal Q3/S3 overlay scan over processed sleep lag and baseline-deviation features.

construction.delta_lag1: Current processed sleep-proxy value minus lag1.
construction.dev_roll3_mean: Current processed sleep-proxy value minus past rolling mean.
construction.lag1: Previous available same-subject processed sleep-proxy value.
construction.roll3_mean_past: Past-only same-subject rolling mean over up to 3 previous rows.
construction.roll3_std_past: Past-only same-subject rolling standard deviation over up to 3 previous rows.
